name: Elasticsearch - Overview
description: The Elasticsearch - Overview dashboard provides the health of Elasticsearch clusters, shards analysis, resource utilization of Elasticsearch host & clusters,  search and indexing performance.
title: Elasticsearch - Overview

queries.queryString: db_cluster=* metric=elasticsearch_os_cpu_percent  db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | sum by db_cluster, host  | eval _value/100
db_cluster=*  metric=elasticsearch_clusterstats_nodes_jvm_mem_heap_used_in_bytes db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | sum by db_cluster, host
db_cluster=* metric=elasticsearch_fs_total_free_in_bytes  db_cluster={{db_cluster}}  | sum by db_cluster, host
db_cluster=* metric=elasticsearch_fs_total_total_in_bytes db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | sum by db_cluster, host
(1-(#A/#B))*100 along db_cluster | sum by db_cluster, host
db_cluster=* metric=elasticsearch_jvm_gc_collectors_*_collection_time_in_millis db_cluster={{db_cluster}}   | sum by db_cluster, host

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "ERROR" or level = "FATAL"
| count by component

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "WARN"
| count by component

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "WARN" and message matches "*took_millis*"
| count

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| where level = "WARN" and message matches "*took_millis*"
| timeslice 1 h
| count by _timeslice

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level
| json field=_raw "component" as component
| json field=_raw "message" as message
| timeslice 1h
| count by component, _timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column component

db_cluster=* db_system=elasticsearch db_cluster={{db_cluster}} | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "level" as level

| json field=_raw "message" as message
